trigram_control_preservation_audit.ngram_hash_format: numeric lexicographic rows of little-endian uint32 IDs; duplicates retained

definitions.observed_only_spearman: Spearman of fixed weight score versus corpus occurrence count restricted to IDs with count > 0; averaged ties.
definitions.presence_auc: Mann-Whitney rank formula with average ties; probability score(observed ID) exceeds score(absent ID), counting a tie as one-half.

limitations: Post-hoc diagnostics, not additions to the frozen ranking selection or extraction protocol.
Full-vocabulary Spearman includes zero-count IDs and conflates presence separation with frequency ordering.
No scores or candidates changed; committed verifier output and source are unchanged.
posthoc_observed_only_frequency_and_pres.algorithm: Map aligned frozen scores back to canonical token IDs; count native token occurrences; retain IDs with count>0 for Spearman with average exact-tie ranks. For presence ROC-AUC use (sum(full-vocabulary average ranks of present IDs)-n_present*(n_present+1)/2)/(n_present*n_absent).

constraints: each token ID occurs at most twice
limitations: Necessary constraints only; a window may still be absent from frozen top-four edges or beam search.
No vocabulary selection, candidate generation, or ranking was changed based on these counts.
posthoc_decoder_compatible_ceiling.algorithm: For each k, use prefix sums to count windows with no token outside S and no adjacent equality. Sort each surviving k-token window and reject if any sorted[j]==sorted[j+2]. Longest valid window is found by a two-pointer scan resetting on an outside-S token or adjacent equality and advancing the left endpoint until each count<=2.

membership_only_ceiling_scope: Necessary selected-vocabulary membership only; actual decoder-compatible ceiling is reported separately. Do not equate membership-only length12 windows with recoverable paths.
